usedFor: Shopify holds products, and TickTick holds tasks, so “New Product” can open a project with “Create Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Project” in TickTick
bestTemplate.why: A new product gets its own project, so launch work has a place from the start.

watchOut: “Delete Project” is also an action here, so keep it away from the same trigger.
